Technical Specification: Cloud Migration Framework
Version 2.1 - Last Updated December 2025
This document outlines the technical architecture for migrating on-premises infrastructure to a hybrid cloud environment. The framework supports AWS, Azure, and GCP as target platforms.
1. Architecture Overview
The migration framework consists of three core components: the Discovery Agent, the Migration Engine, and the Validation Suite. Each component operates independently and communicates via a message queue.
2. Data Transfer Protocol
Data transfer uses AES-256 encryption in transit with checksums verified at both source and destination. Maximum transfer rate is configurable up to 10 Gbps per stream.
